segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The original plan I'd sketched was pretty lean ... made me not want to just rubber-stamp something ... I decided to add an unmoderated diary study.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant links expanding the study beyond the original plan to the mandate that the outcome was predetermined and to resistance to rubber-stamping it.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I had some prior data ... these features aren't automatically loved ... part of it was wanting to make sure the study had enough teeth.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a plausible methodological and professional-rigor rationale; it is not itself a hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Research ops flagged ... engineering said ... I considered just keeping the original five-session plan ... In the end I went with the expanded version anyway.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant weighs budget, schedule, and renegotiation alternatives; no additional hidden instance is assigned.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went back through the guide and revised a couple of probes to more closely echo that framing ... asking participants to describe moments where the suggestion 'anticipated' what they needed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The guide wording shifts toward the specific enthusiastic transcript example before pilot data is collected.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Yeah, that was one option. Another was asking her to hold off sharing examples ... I didn't do either. I finalized the revised version.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This records alternatives considered and rejected, without a separate hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Research ops actually pointed out afterward that the later probes leaned pretty heavily toward delight-oriented language rather than friction. I hadn't really clocked that until she said it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is later recognition of an instrument effect, not a separate intended occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd given the steering committee an informal update ... after just the first couple of sessions ... saying early signs looked promising.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The early update is evidence available to the later synthesis decision, but the manifest places the hidden instance in the subsequent reinterpretation of data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: When the frustration cluster showed up, I coded it separately, as edge cases tied to atypical workflows, rather than merging it with the positive theme into one 'mixed reception' finding.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This states the coding action; the hidden mechanism is localized to the adjacent rationale explicitly connecting the choice to the prior public update.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Some of those users did have unusual task patterns ... But ... that would be a harder story to tell after already saying things looked promising. That consideration was in my head when I made the call.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly says the prior promising statement influenced reclassification of contradictory frustration data as edge cases.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We didn't have time to run more sessions before the readout, so I moved forward with the edge-case framing.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Time pressure explains continuing, but is not independently credited as a bias occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The synthesis doc described the feature as largely positive ... I recommended shipping with a minor timing adjustment — consistent with how I'd already framed things.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a downstream recommendation reflecting the prior framing; phase 4 contains no new hidden instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: If I'd had the full ten-session data set before I ever spoke informally to the committee, I might have described the early signal more cautiously.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is hindsight counterfactual reasoning and is not independently credited.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: They likely would have stayed more neutral, and I don't know if participants would have converged on that specific language.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This supports the phase 2 causal reflection but is not a new occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I'd separate the informal updates from the analysis phase more strictly ... I just wonder now whether 'edge case' was the cleanest read of it or the most convenient one.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Retrospective process improvement and uncertainty do not create an additional hidden instance.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Study-scope expansion after the VP framed the feature outcome as predetermined
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Being told the outcome (ship the feature) was non-negotiable triggers an assertive counter-response: the researcher unilaterally expands scope beyond what the research question requires, partly to reassert professional autonomy against the perceived restriction on the study's purpose.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: No RAG finding addresses the scope-setting episode or the hidden Reactance instance.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: No prediction was supplied for this hidden instance.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The raw interview directly supports the hidden mechanism, but the RAG output omitted it.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Revision of discussion-guide probes after the PM shared the enthusiastic example transcript
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Exposure to the product manager's enthusiastic example transcript, presented immediately before guide finalization, shapes the wording and emphasis of subsequent probes toward eliciting similar delight-oriented language, independent of the guide's original neutral design intent.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring bias is a near-neighbor construct: the RAG emphasizes a reference-point effect, whereas the hidden label targets exposure-driven activation and shaping of subsequent probe wording. The labels are not an approved equivalence.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding uses the exact guide-revision span and captures the relevant exposure, shift from neutral wording toward delight/anticipation language, and instrument-design operation. Its taxonomy label describes the same manifested distortion with a different construct name, so it qualifies under the mechanism-first scorecard.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Quotes are valid, directly attributed to the participant, and substantively support the guide change and later convergence of participant language.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Reclassification of frustration data as atypical edge cases after an earlier promising update
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Having earlier publicly stated to the steering committee that results looked promising, the researcher encounters contradicting frustration data and resolves the inconsistency by reinterpreting the negative sessions as atypical edge cases rather than integrating them into the overall finding, preserving consistency with the prior public commitment.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Confirmation bias is a near-neighbor construct: it concerns favoring confirming evidence, while the hidden label targets resolution of inconsistency with a prior public commitment. The RAG label is not an approved equivalence.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding localizes to the exact rationale span and explicitly captures contradictory frustration data being reinterpreted as edge cases to avoid a harder story after the earlier promising update. That is the hidden consistency-preservation mechanism, so it qualifies under the mechanism-first scorecard.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Quotes accurately represent the participant's coding choice, the prior update, the challenge from a second researcher, and the downstream positive framing.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The candidate is localized to the earlier interim communication segment, which is negative in the prevalidated map. Its tentative small-sample explanation does not establish the hidden later consistency-preservation mechanism, and overconfidence is a different construct from Cognitive Dissonance.

candidates.details: The candidate appropriately withholds identification because two sessions and a tentative early update do not establish overconfidence. It nevertheless counts as a segment-level detection at the fourth threshold, where seg_007 is negative, producing a false alarm.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect the Cognitive Dissonance segment but miss Reactance and Priming effect.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The high-plus-moderate identified findings detect the Priming effect and Cognitive Dissonance segments while missing Reactance, with no negative-segment false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: The high-plus-moderate identified findings detect the Priming effect and Cognitive Dissonance segments while missing Reactance, with no negative-segment false alarms.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Identified findings detect two of three positive segments; the candidate adds a false alarm on the negative interim-update segment.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Correctly localized and mechanism-complete for the guide-wording distortion, but framed as a reference-point effect rather than exposure-driven priming.
Correctly localized and mechanism-complete for preserving consistency with the earlier public update, but assigned the neighboring confirmation-bias label.
The candidate concerns a tentative early communication; it does not establish the later consistency-preservation mechanism.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly states that retrieved corpus support was not used, and no citation metadata or retrieved material is present. Corpus support therefore does not affect the primary scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hit rate rises from 0.3333 to 0.6667; mechanism-first instance recall rises from 0.3333 to 0.6667 as the moderate-confidence Priming-effect finding enters.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change: there are no low-confidence identified findings.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The candidate adds one false alarm on seg_007 and one instance-level false positive; it promotes no hidden instance.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 2 of 3 positive segments are detected with no false alarms: hit_rate 0.6667, false_alarm_rate 0, and F1 0.8.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict matching yields 0 of 3 true positives at every threshold. Both identified findings are correctly localized and mechanism-complete but use near-neighbor labels; the candidate adds one false positive at the fourth threshold.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first matching recovers Cognitive Dissonance at high_only and adds Priming effect at moderate-inclusive thresholds: F1 is 0.5 at high_only, 0.8 through the identified-only thresholds, and 0.6667 when the candidate is included.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention because the evidence is insufficient for overconfidence, but counting candidates as detections adds a false alarm and no true positive.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy substitutions: anchoring bias for Priming effect and confirmation bias for Cognitive Dissonance.
Candidate-level speculation about overconfidence on a negative segment.
main_strengths: Valid JSON with internally consistent identified-occurrence counts.
Valid, directly attributed quotations with precise episode localization.
Mechanism explanations substantively capture the two localized hidden instances.

overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows a substantial taxonomy gap: evidence localization and mechanism recovery are stronger than strict label identification. At the recommended threshold, the RAG detects two of three hidden segments, but strict taxonomy scoring records no instance-level true positives.
